q: I ran source app.env, but my script still doesn't see DB_HOST. Why?
opts: The variables aren't exported. Use set -a before source
expl: Sourcing sets shell variables only. set -a exports everything assigned while it's on.

q: sudo printenv DB_HOST prints nothing. How do I keep just that variable?
expl: Sudo resets the environment. --preserve-env with a name lets exactly that variable through.
